sections.heading: Robert Pattinson — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Robert Pattinson was born on 13 May 1986 in London, and holds British nationality. He was given the name Robert Douglas Thomas Pattinson at birth and is publicly known as Robert Pattinson.
Public records name his father, Richard Pattinson and his mother, Clare. He is a sibling of Lizzy Pattinson.
He received his education at The Harrodian School and Tower House School.
He is recorded as speaking English.
